purpose: Record the dated post-GALVANIC learning effect on expected Japanese land-base fighter exchange without retroactively rewriting realized GALVANIC losses or turning C2 into a universal kill multiplier.

metric_definition.name: favorable_exchange_index
metric_definition.meaning: Relative multiplier on expected enemy combat losses per Japanese combat loss under otherwise matched aircraft, pilot, mission and target conditions, compared with the same Branch unit before the post-GALVANIC procedural learning was absorbed.
metric_definition.use_rule: Apply through warning/readiness/initial-energy/section-control stages. If those stages are absent or suppressed, use the lower maturity band rather than adding the index anyway.

dated_transition.rule: Battle is the learning trigger. Keep macro centers Japan 67 / US 44 irrecoverable aircraft and existing microcombat result unchanged.

dated_transition.context: priority fixed bases absorb immediate lessons
dated_transition.main_causes: readiness staging, section discipline, cue-to-confirm procedure, refusal of low-value chase; hardware essentially unchanged

dated_transition.context: A-grade base procedures stabilized; EW/field-service system already material
dated_transition.main_causes: better layered readiness, radio procedure, plot-to-intercept handoff, maintenance/availability discipline

dated_transition.context: post-GALVANIC learning plus Q1 calibration/test-procedure improvement
dated_transition.main_causes: warning/plot reliability, staged alert, section control, radar/radio field service and more disciplined energy geometry; still below US precision GCI/CIC

target_and_mission_gates.medium_altitude_heavy_bomber_raid: A-grade fixed-base band may be used if warning network remains intact and interceptor has sufficient altitude performance.
target_and_mission_gates.B29_high_altitude: Do not apply full A-grade exchange shift to standard Raiden at 8.5-10 km. First gate variant/altitude capability; only then use warning/C2 effect on opportunity quality.
target_and_mission_gates.carrier_fighter_battle: Use carrier-CAP band only; fixed-base plot/radar maturity is not transferable.
target_and_mission_gates.radar_suppressed_base: Downgrade one or more maturity grades depending on remaining visual/DF/radio picture. Platform performance is unchanged but geometry advantage collapses.
target_and_mission_gates.poor_weather_or_broken_radio: Use lower band or zero incremental shift if the cue-to-visual/section-control chain fails.

past_event_application.December_outer_Marshall_pressure: No centered aircraft-loss adjudication exists to rewrite. If later reconstructed, use early-December maturity rather than Jan-28 maturity.
past_event_application.Jan_28_and_later_Flintlock_equivalent: Prospective use of Jan-28 maturity is allowed, subject to base-specific suppression and aircraft-type gates.

why_this_is_not_double_counting: Airframe median/reliability is modeled in the aircraft platform layer.
Radar production/field-service is modeled in the sensor/readiness layer.
This ledger captures the post-battle procedural conversion of those existing assets into better initial geometry and section control.
Do not separately add a generic 'GALVANIC lesson bonus' after using this ledger.
